QF.id: Cat III AIF Due Diligence and Risk_20

question.text: An investor doing DD on a Cat III AIF should examine:

answer.text: PPM, audited financials, quarterly disclosures/reports, on-site meetings with the manager/team, and additional information requests

explanation.text: The Logic: Comprehensive fund due diligence is anchored in the PPM, audited books/financial reports, quarterly risk/performance disclosures, investment-manager/team meetings, and additional information or documents requested by the investor. The Trap: Single-source DD based only on marketing collateral, social media, or newsletters misses the disclosures and manager interactions on which fund-level due diligence relies. Note: Build the DD checklist around the PPM and audited/quarterly disclosures, supplemented by manager meetings and any additional information requests.
